workflows.source:
name: Guardrails

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
      - master

jobs:
  repo-guardrails:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12.5"

      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22.14.0"
          cache: "npm"
          cache-dependency-path: |
            webapp/package-lock.json
            adminapp/package-lock.json
            marketing/package-lock.json

      - name: Validate dependency contract
        run: python scripts/check_dependency_contract.py

      - name: Install backend dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install pip==26.1.2
          python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-test.txt
          npm install --global npm@11.7.0

      - name: Install webapp dependencies
        run: |
          cd webapp
          npm ci
          npx playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - name: Install adminapp dependencies
        run: |
          cd adminapp
          npm ci
          npx playwright install chromium

      - name: Install marketing dependencies
        run: |
          cd marketing
          npm ci

      - name: Validate canonical adminapp candidate
        run: |
          cd adminapp
          npm run check:sdk
          npm run lint
          npm run build
          npm run verify:cutover
          npm run test:e2e

      - name: Validate script manifest references
        run: python scripts/check_script_manifest.py

      - name: Validate generated artifacts and public wording
        run: python scripts/ci_check_artifacts.py --check-copy

      - name: Validate shared-facts and release-handoff contracts
        run: python -m unittest tests.test_shared_surface_facts tests.test_remote_brain_apply_release_handoff tests.test_release_orchestrator tests.test_smoke_client_apps

      - name: Validate support signing custody controls
        run: python -m pytest -q tests/test_verify_support_signing_custody.py tests/test_support_signing_custody_workflow.py

      - name: Quick release gate
        run: python scripts/release_gate_check.py --quick --allow-missing-client-root

name: Release v2 Contract

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  cross-repository-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout platform candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          path: platform

      - name: Checkout active client promotion line
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: Kiwunaka/POKROV-app
          # PR 20 assembles the exact unmerged 1.2.0 tuple. Pushes and every
          # other PR continue to validate the client promotion line.
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'pull_request' && github.event.pull_request.number == 20 && '879970d9e44f2375f9d00f4f12eebcc9bfc568b7' || 'main' }}
          path: POKROV-app
          ssh-key: ${{ secrets.POKROV_RELEASE_CLIENT_DEPLOY_KEY }}
          lfs: true
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout Core promotion line
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: Kiwunaka/pokrov-core
          ref: main
          path: POKROV-core
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12.5"

      - name: Validate dependency contract
        working-directory: platform
        run: python scripts/check_dependency_contract.py

      - name: Materialize bound Core source authority
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $candidateRoot = Join-Path "${{ github.workspace }}" "POKROV-core"
          $authorityRoot = Join-Path "${{ github.workspace }}" "POKROV-core-authority"
          $seedPath = Join-Path "${{ github.workspace }}" "POKROV-app/config/runtime-artifacts.seed.json"
          $boundCore = (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $seedPath | ConvertFrom-Json).core.source_commit
          if ($boundCore -notmatch "^[0-9a-f]{40}$") {
            throw "Client runtime seed does not contain a full Core source commit."
          }

          & git -C $candidateRoot cat-file -e "$boundCore^{commit}"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Bound Core source commit is unavailable in the candidate checkout."
          }

          & git -C $candidateRoot diff --quiet $boundCore HEAD -- . ":(exclude).github/**"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Core promotion line changed bound source outside .github while client/main still pins $boundCore."
          }

          & git -C $candidateRoot worktree add --detach $authorityRoot $boundCore
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Failed to materialize the bound Core source authority."
          }

      - name: Validate cross-repository release-handoff v2 contract
        working-directory: platform
        run: >-
          python scripts/run_client_release_gate.py contract
          --client-root "${{ github.workspace }}/POKROV-app"
          --core-root "${{ github.workspace }}/POKROV-core-authority"

name: Support Signing Custody

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/support-signing-custody.yml
      - scripts/verify_support_signing_custody.py
      - tests/test_verify_support_signing_custody.py
      - tests/test_support_signing_custody_workflow.py
      - requirements-ops.txt
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  verify-hosted-custody:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/master'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout trusted platform promotion line
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.sha }}
          path: platform
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout active client public pin
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: Kiwunaka/POKROV-app
          ref: main
          path: POKROV-app
          ssh-key: ${{ secrets.POKROV_RELEASE_CLIENT_DEPLOY_KEY }}
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: config/support-signing.seed.json
          sparse-checkout-cone-mode: false

      - name: Capture exact public revisions
        id: revisions
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          echo "platform=$(git -C platform rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "client=$(git -C POKROV-app rev-parse HEAD)" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12.5"

      - name: Install locked verifier dependencies
        working-directory: platform
        run: |
          python scripts/check_dependency_contract.py
          python -m pip install pip==26.1.2
          python -m pip install --require-hashes -r requirements-ops.txt

      - name: Verify hosted custody against client pin
        working-directory: platform
        env:
          POKROV_SUPPORT_MODE_SIGNING_KEY_ID: ${{ vars.POKROV_SUPPORT_MODE_SIGNING_KEY_ID }}
          POKROV_SUPPORT_MODE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_B64: ${{ vars.POKROV_SUPPORT_MODE_SIGNING_PUBLIC_KEY_B64 }}
          POKROV_SUPPORT_MODE_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_B64: ${{ secrets.POKROV_SUPPORT_MODE_SIGNING_PRIVATE_KEY_B64 }}
          POKROV_SUPPORT_MODE_CODE_SECRET: ${{ secrets.POKROV_SUPPORT_MODE_CODE_SECRET }}
        run: >-
          python scripts/verify_support_signing_custody.py
          --client-seed "${{ github.workspace }}/POKROV-app/config/support-signing.seed.json"
          --platform-revision "${{ steps.revisions.outputs.platform }}"
          --client-revision "${{ steps.revisions.outputs.client }}"
          --output "${{ runner.temp }}/support-signing-custody-receipt.json"

      - name: Upload public custody receipt
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: support-signing-custody-${{ steps.revisions.outputs.platform }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/support-signing-custody-receipt.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

name: Release v2 Contract

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      client_ref:
        description: Exact 40-character client commit for a retained-candidate replay
        required: true
        type: string
      platform_ref:
        description: Exact 40-character platform commit for the same candidate
        required: true
        type: string
      core_ref:
        description: Exact 40-character Core commit for the same candidate
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  cross-repository-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - name: Reclaim unused runner disk
        shell: bash
        run: |
          df -h /
          sudo rm -rf -- /usr/share/dotnet
          sudo rm -rf -- /opt/ghc
          sudo rm -rf -- /usr/local/share/boost
          sudo rm -rf -- /opt/hostedtoolcache/CodeQL
          sudo apt-get clean
          df -h /

      - name: Validate exact replay refs
        if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch'
        shell: bash
        env:
          CLIENT_REF: ${{ inputs.client_ref }}
          PLATFORM_REF: ${{ inputs.platform_ref }}
          CORE_REF: ${{ inputs.core_ref }}
        run: |
          for ref in "$CLIENT_REF" "$PLATFORM_REF" "$CORE_REF"; do
            if [[ ! "$ref" =~ ^[0-9a-f]{40}$ ]]; then
              echo "Manual exact replay requires three lowercase full commit SHAs."
              exit 1
            fi
          done

      - name: Checkout client candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.client_ref || github.sha }}
          path: client
          lfs: true

      - name: Checkout platform promotion line
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          repository: Kiwunaka/portal
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.platform_ref || 'master' }}
          path: platform
          ssh-key: ${{ secrets.POKROV_RELEASE_PLATFORM_DEPLOY_KEY }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Checkout Core promotion line
        uses: actions/checkout@v7
        with:
          repository: Kiwunaka/pokrov-core
          ref: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.core_ref || 'main' }}
          path: POKROV-core
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Materialize bound Core source authority
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $candidateRoot = Join-Path "${{ github.workspace }}" "POKROV-core"
          $authorityRoot = Join-Path "${{ github.workspace }}" "POKROV-core-authority"
          $seedPath = Join-Path "${{ github.workspace }}" "client/config/runtime-artifacts.seed.json"
          $boundCore = (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $seedPath | ConvertFrom-Json).core.source_commit
          if ($boundCore -notmatch "^[0-9a-f]{40}$") {
            throw "Client runtime seed does not contain a full Core source commit."
          }

          & git -C $candidateRoot cat-file -e "$boundCore^{commit}"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Bound Core source commit is unavailable in the promotion-line checkout."
          }

          & git -C $candidateRoot diff --quiet $boundCore HEAD -- . ":(exclude).github/**"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Core promotion line changed bound source outside .github while client/main still pins $boundCore."
          }

          & git -C $candidateRoot worktree add --detach $authorityRoot $boundCore
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Failed to materialize the bound Core source authority."
          }

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v6
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v5
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v7
        with:
          go-version: "1.25.13"
          cache-dependency-path: client/apps/linux_shell/daemon/go.mod

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          flutter-version: "3.38.5"
          cache: true

      - name: Validate cross-repository release-handoff v2 contract
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: client
        run: >-
          ./scripts/validate-seed.ps1
          -PlatformRoot "${{ github.workspace }}/platform"
          -CoreRoot "${{ github.workspace }}/POKROV-core-authority"

      - name: Run client unit and Android flavor tests
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: client
        run: ./scripts/run-tests.ps1

      - name: Validate conditional Linux daemon foundation
        shell: bash
        working-directory: client/apps/linux_shell/daemon
        run: |
          unformatted="$(gofmt -l $(find . -type f -name '*.go'))"
          if [ -n "$unformatted" ]; then
            echo "$unformatted"
            exit 1
          fi
          go test ./...
          go vet ./...
          go build -trimpath -o "$RUNNER_TEMP/pokrov-linuxd" ./cmd/pokrov-linuxd

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

env:
  POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha || github.sha }}

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 45
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT }}
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Verify exact Core source authority
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $actual = (& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          if ($actual -cne $env:POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT) {
            throw "Expected Core source $env:POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT, got $actual."
          }
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 1.26.8
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.sum
            engine/sing-box/go.sum
      - name: Install ripgrep
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install --yes ripgrep
      - name: Test
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/test.ps1

      - name: Vet supported runtime packages
        run: go vet ./internal/observability ./v2/config ./v2/hcore ./v2/hutils ./ray2sing/ray2sing

      - name: Race-test supported runtime packages
        run: go test -race ./internal/observability ./v2/config ./v2/hcore ./v2/hutils ./ray2sing/ray2sing

      - name: Install govulncheck
        run: go install golang.org/x/vuln/cmd/govulncheck@v1.7.0

      - name: Scan supported runtime packages for reachable vulnerabilities
        run: govulncheck ./internal/observability ./v2/config ./v2/hcore ./v2/hutils ./ray2sing/ray2sing

      - name: Vet and race-test mobile Core event bridge
        working-directory: engine/sing-box
        run: |
          go vet ./daemon ./experimental/libbox
          go test -race ./daemon ./experimental/libbox

      - name: Scan mobile Core event bridge for reachable vulnerabilities
        working-directory: engine/sing-box
        run: govulncheck ./daemon ./experimental/libbox

      - name: Install pinned static analysis and SBOM tools
        run: |
          go install honnef.co/go/tools/cmd/staticcheck@v0.7.0
          go install github.com/CycloneDX/cyclonedx-gomod/cmd/cyclonedx-gomod@v1.10.0

      - name: Staticcheck supported release packages
        run: |
          staticcheck -checks='SA2*,SA5*,SA6*' ./internal/observability ./v2/config ./v2/hcore ./v2/hutils ./v2/hcore/tunnelservice ./ray2sing/ray2sing ./ray2sing/cmd
          cd engine/sing-box
          staticcheck -checks='SA2*,SA5*,SA6*' ./daemon ./experimental/libbox ./protocol/awg

      - name: Fuzz the config and profile parser
        run: go test -run=^$ -fuzz=FuzzParseConfigDoesNotPanic -fuzztime=30s ./v2/config

      - name: Generate deterministic dependency and license SBOMs
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-source-sbom"
          cyclonedx-gomod mod -licenses -std -json -notimestamp -noserial -output "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-source-sbom/pokrov-core.cdx.json" .
          cyclonedx-gomod mod -licenses -std -json -notimestamp -noserial -output "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-source-sbom/sing-box.cdx.json" ./engine/sing-box

      - name: Retain source SBOM evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-source-sbom
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/core-source-sbom/*.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  release-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Core candidate
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT }}
          path: POKROV-core
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Checkout active client promotion line
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: Kiwunaka/POKROV-app
          ref: main
          path: client
          lfs: true
          ssh-key: ${{ secrets.POKROV_RELEASE_CLIENT_DEPLOY_KEY }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Verify exact Core source authority
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: POKROV-core
        run: |
          $actual = (& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          if ($actual -cne $env:POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT) {
            throw "Expected Core source $env:POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT, got $actual."
          }

      - name: Checkout platform promotion line
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: Kiwunaka/portal
          ref: master
          path: platform
          ssh-key: ${{ secrets.POKROV_RELEASE_PLATFORM_DEPLOY_KEY }}
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Materialize bound Core source authority
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $candidateRoot = Join-Path "${{ github.workspace }}" "POKROV-core"
          $authorityRoot = Join-Path "${{ github.workspace }}" "POKROV-core-authority"
          $seedPath = Join-Path "${{ github.workspace }}" "client/config/runtime-artifacts.seed.json"
          $boundCore = (Get-Content -Raw -LiteralPath $seedPath | ConvertFrom-Json).core.source_commit
          if ($boundCore -notmatch "^[0-9a-f]{40}$") {
            throw "Client runtime seed does not contain a full Core source commit."
          }

          & git -C $candidateRoot cat-file -e "$boundCore^{commit}"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Bound Core source commit is unavailable in the candidate checkout."
          }

          & git -C $candidateRoot diff --quiet $boundCore HEAD -- . ":(exclude).github/**"
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Core candidate changes bound source outside .github while client/main still pins $boundCore."
          }

          & git -C $candidateRoot worktree add --detach $authorityRoot $boundCore
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) {
            throw "Failed to materialize the bound Core source authority."
          }

      - name: Validate client, Core, and release-handoff v2 parity
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: client
        run: >-
          ./scripts/validate-seed.ps1
          -PlatformRoot "${{ github.workspace }}/platform"
          -CoreRoot "${{ github.workspace }}/POKROV-core-authority"

  android-artifact-reproducibility:
    needs: test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 90
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Core source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify exact Core source authority
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $actual = (& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          if ($actual -cne $env:POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT) {
            throw "Expected Core source $env:POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT, got $actual."
          }

      - name: Setup Python for deterministic XCFramework metadata
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.12"

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 1.26.8
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.sum
            engine/sing-box/go.sum

      - name: Setup Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: "17"

      - name: Download source SBOM evidence
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-source-sbom
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/core-source-sbom

      - name: Build Android AAR first pass
        shell: pwsh
        run: >-
          ./scripts/build-android.ps1
          -AndroidSdk "$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"
          -GomobileBinDirectory "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/gomobile"
          -OutputDirectory "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-android-a"

      - name: Build Android AAR second pass
        shell: pwsh
        run: >-
          ./scripts/build-android.ps1
          -AndroidSdk "$env:ANDROID_SDK_ROOT"
          -GomobileBinDirectory "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/gomobile"
          -OutputDirectory "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-android-b"

      - name: Compare Android builds and write bounded provenance
        shell: pwsh
        run: >-
          ./scripts/new-release-artifact-evidence.ps1
          -Lane android
          -FirstBuildRoot "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-android-a"
          -SecondBuildRoot "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-android-b"
          -Sbom "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-source-sbom/pokrov-core.cdx.json","$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-source-sbom/sing-box.cdx.json"
          -Output "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-android-evidence.json"
          -RequireCleanSource

      - name: Retain Android pre-candidate evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-android-pre-candidate-evidence
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/core-android-evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  windows-artifact-reproducibility:
    needs: test
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Core source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT }}
          path: POKROV-core
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify exact Core source authority
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: POKROV-core
        run: |
          $actual = (& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          if ($actual -cne $env:POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT) {
            throw "Expected Core source $env:POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT, got $actual."
          }

      - name: Checkout active client for pinned Cronet and 100-cycle backtest
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: Kiwunaka/POKROV-app
          ref: main
          path: client
          ssh-key: ${{ secrets.POKROV_RELEASE_CLIENT_DEPLOY_KEY }}
          persist-credentials: false
          lfs: true

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 1.26.8
          cache-dependency-path: |
            POKROV-core/go.sum
            POKROV-core/engine/sing-box/go.sum

      - name: Setup Flutter
        uses: subosito/flutter-action@v2
        with:
          channel: stable
          flutter-version: "3.38.5"
          cache: true

      - name: Install pinned MinGW-w64
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          choco install mingw --version=13.2.0 --yes --no-progress
          $compiler = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath C:\ProgramData\mingw64 -Filter gcc.exe -File -Recurse | Select-Object -First 1
          if (-not $compiler) { throw "Pinned MinGW-w64 compiler was not installed." }
          "POKROV_MINGW_GCC=$($compiler.FullName)" | Out-File -FilePath $env:GITHUB_ENV -Encoding utf8 -Append

      - name: Download source SBOM evidence
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-source-sbom
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/core-source-sbom

      - name: Build Windows DLL first pass
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: POKROV-core
        run: |
          if (-not $env:POKROV_MINGW_GCC -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:POKROV_MINGW_GCC -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Pinned MinGW-w64 compiler was not resolved." }
          $cronet = "${{ github.workspace }}\client\apps\windows_shell\windows\runner\resources\runtime\libcronet.dll"
          ./scripts/build-windows.ps1 -CCompiler $env:POKROV_MINGW_GCC -CronetLibrary $cronet -OutputDirectory "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-windows-a"

      - name: Build Windows DLL second pass
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: POKROV-core
        run: |
          if (-not $env:POKROV_MINGW_GCC -or -not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $env:POKROV_MINGW_GCC -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Pinned MinGW-w64 compiler was not resolved." }
          $cronet = "${{ github.workspace }}\client\apps\windows_shell\windows\runner\resources\runtime\libcronet.dll"
          ./scripts/build-windows.ps1 -CCompiler $env:POKROV_MINGW_GCC -CronetLibrary $cronet -OutputDirectory "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-windows-b"

      - name: Run the current-source DLL 100-cycle proxy backtest
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: client
        run: ./scripts/test-windows-core-proxy-only.ps1 -CoreRoot "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-windows-a"

      - name: Compare Windows builds and write bounded provenance
        shell: pwsh
        working-directory: POKROV-core
        run: >-
          ./scripts/new-release-artifact-evidence.ps1
          -Lane windows
          -FirstBuildRoot "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-windows-a"
          -SecondBuildRoot "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-windows-b"
          -Sbom "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-source-sbom/pokrov-core.cdx.json","$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-source-sbom/sing-box.cdx.json"
          -Output "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-windows-evidence.json"
          -RequireCleanSource

      - name: Retain Windows pre-candidate evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-windows-pre-candidate-evidence
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/core-windows-evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

  apple-source-build:
    needs: test
    runs-on: macos-15
    timeout-minutes: 120
    steps:
      - name: Checkout Core source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          ref: ${{ env.POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT }}
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Verify exact Core source authority
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $actual = (& git rev-parse HEAD).Trim()
          if ($actual -cne $env:POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT) {
            throw "Expected Core source $env:POKROV_SOURCE_COMMIT, got $actual."
          }

      - name: Setup Go
        uses: actions/setup-go@v5
        with:
          go-version: 1.26.8
          cache-dependency-path: |
            go.sum
            engine/sing-box/go.sum

      - name: Download source SBOM evidence
        uses: actions/download-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-source-sbom
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/core-source-sbom

      - name: Build Apple XCFramework first pass
        shell: bash
        run: bash ./scripts/build-apple.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-apple-a"

      - name: Build Apple XCFramework second pass
        shell: bash
        run: bash ./scripts/build-apple.sh "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-apple-b"

      - name: Diagnose Apple reproducibility inputs
        shell: bash
        run: >-
          bash ./scripts/diagnose-apple-reproducibility.sh
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-apple-a"
          "$RUNNER_TEMP/core-apple-b"

      - name: Compare Apple builds and write bounded provenance
        shell: pwsh
        run: >-
          ./scripts/new-release-artifact-evidence.ps1
          -Lane apple
          -FirstBuildRoot "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-apple-a"
          -SecondBuildRoot "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-apple-b"
          -Sbom "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-source-sbom/pokrov-core.cdx.json","$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-source-sbom/sing-box.cdx.json"
          -Output "$env:RUNNER_TEMP/core-apple-evidence.json"
          -RequireCleanSource

      - name: Retain Apple source-build evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: core-apple-pre-candidate-evidence
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/core-apple-evidence.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

name: Prepare signed candidate manifest

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      template_path:
        description: Tracked candidate template path under candidate-inputs/1.2.0
        required: true
        type: string
      template_sha256:
        description: Reviewed SHA-256 of the exact tracked template bytes
        required: true
        type: string
      candidate_id:
        description: Exact candidate id expected inside the template
        required: true
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: prepare-signed-candidate-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare-signed-candidate:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact main revision
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Python 3.13
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: requirements-release.txt

      - name: Install pinned release validator dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --requirement requirements-release.txt

      - name: Prepare and sign exact candidate manifest
        env:
          POKROV_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_PEM: ${{ secrets.POKROV_RELEASE_SIGNING_KEY_PEM }}
          TEMPLATE_PATH: ${{ inputs.template_path }}
          TEMPLATE_SHA256: ${{ inputs.template_sha256 }}
          CANDIDATE_ID: ${{ inputs.candidate_id }}
        run: >-
          python -B scripts/sign_release_index.py
          --template "${TEMPLATE_PATH}"
          --template-sha256 "${TEMPLATE_SHA256}"
          --candidate-id "${CANDIDATE_ID}"
          --release-index-commit "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          --output-dir "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pokrov-signed-candidate"

      - name: Revalidate signed output without private key
        run: >-
          python -B scripts/validate_release_index.py
          --require-ready
          --manifest "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pokrov-signed-candidate/release-index.json"
          --signature "${RUNNER_TEMP}/pokrov-signed-candidate/release-index.json.sig"

      - name: Upload signed candidate evidence only
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@ea165f8d65b6e75b540449e92b4886f43607fa02 # v4.6.2
        with:
          name: pokrov-${{ inputs.candidate_id }}-signed-manifest-${{ github.sha }}
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/pokrov-signed-candidate/
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14
          compression-level: 0
          overwrite: false
          include-hidden-files: false

name: Release index contract

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: release-index-contract-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  source-contract:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact revision
        uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4

      - name: Set up Python 3.13
        uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065 # v5
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"
          cache: pip
          cache-dependency-path: requirements-release.txt

      - name: Install pinned release validator dependencies
        run: python -m pip install --requirement requirements-release.txt

      - name: Validate source contract
        run: python -B scripts/validate_release_index.py

      - name: Run release-index tests
        run: python -B -m unittest discover -s tests -v
